🤖 Karma bot

Commands:
• `@{{.BotUsername}} start` — enable karma in the channel
• `@{{.BotUsername}} stop` — pause karma in the channel
• `@{{.BotUsername}} ++ @user [@user2 …]` — give karma (+1 to each)
• `@{{.BotUsername}} top` — top-10 for the period
• `@{{.BotUsername}} help` — cheat sheet
